step1_analysis.description: A sub-circuit of a switched-current comparator. It consists of PMOS current sources and a diode-connected NMOS, likely acting as a current combiner or bias stage for the comparator.

paper_reference.title: Design techniques for a high-performance switched-current (SI) comparator suitable for low supply voltage operation

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the sub-circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law model for SKY130 PMOS with Vsg=0.9V. Lower than the paper's reported value because this is only a sub-block of the full comparator, and SKY130 uses a lower 1.8V supply.

voltage_gain.description: AC voltage gain from N2 to N0

sky130_expected.calculation: gm_p = 240uS. Gain = 2 * gm_p * Rload = 2 * 240u * 5k = 2.4 V/V = 7.6 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the transconductance (gm) of the PMOS current sources and a 5k ohm load resistor added to the testbench to prevent floating nodes.

bandwidth.description: Frequency at which AC gain drops to 0 dB

sky130_expected.reasoning: Parasitic capacitance of small transistors is low, leading to high bandwidth with a 5k load. The 130nm process is faster than the likely older technology used in the 2001 paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient response of the switched-current sub-circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched-Current Amplifier Sub-circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

XM1 N0 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 N1 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN2 N2 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
RLOAD N0 0 5k

.control
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N0) v(N1)

ac dec 100 1k 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N0)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=10k
meas ac bw when gain_db=0 fall=1

tran 1n 1u
meas tran v_max max v(N0)
meas tran v_min min v(N0)

quit
.endc
